from donations import load_donations, ROWS
from shares import pounds_shares, stored_shares


def test_stored_shares():
    shares = stored_shares()
    assert len(shares) == len(ROWS)


def test_shares_of_a_list():
    shares = pounds_shares(list(load_donations()))
    assert abs(sum(shares) - 1.0) < 1e-9
